Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 1b) demonstrates bilateral widening of the lower posterior mediastinum with lateral displacement of both paraspinal lines (indicated by arrowheads), a classic radiographic sign of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving the paravertebral regions. The absence of vertebral destruction and respiratory symptoms further supports this diagnosis over neurogenic tumors, abscesses, or metastatic disease.
